plan.subject: Understand the fundamental concepts of Boolean algebra and its applications in digital logic circuits, including truth tables, simplification techniques, and Karnaugh maps.
plan.objective: Understand the fundamental concepts of Boolean algebra and its applications in digital logic circuits, including truth tables, simplification techniques, and Karnaugh maps.

blocks.title: Boolean Algebra and Its Axioms
blocks.teachingObjective: Boolean algebra is the foundation of digital logic circuits and is essential for representing and simplifying logic functions.
examples: axioms and theorems of Boolean algebra, including identities, complementarity, and distributivity

blocks.title: Truth Tables and Logic Expressions
blocks.teachingObjective: Truth tables provide a clear way to represent the behavior of logic functions and are used to derive Boolean expressions.
examples: truth tables for logic functions, Boolean expressions for logic functions

blocks.title: Simplification of Boolean Expressions
blocks.teachingObjective: Simplifying Boolean expressions reduces the complexity of digital circuits, leading to more efficient designs.
examples: rewriting method for proving Boolean theorems, distributivity theorem

blocks.title: Karnaugh Maps and Logic Simplification
blocks.teachingObjective: Karnaugh maps provide a visual method to simplify Boolean expressions and identify prime implicants.
examples: Karnaugh map as a graphical representation of a truth table, K-map rules for identifying prime implicants
